Aug 2026 • Couples
A very memorable experience at the Mediterranean restaurant. The space is beautiful, cozy, and has a very unique style. The dishes are presented elegantly, the flavors are balanced, the ingredients are fresh, and it is especially impressive with the steaks and dishes inspired by locally caught ingredients of the day.

The service staff are always smiling, friendly, and very attentive. The dish is both visually appealing and creative, yet it retains its characteristic features.

A very worthwhile place for dates, meeting friends, or a special dinner. The rooftop is very spacious, suitable for organizing various types of events. Will definitely come back!
